subject: Service integrity incident — throughput & error spike: remediation docket and owner commitments
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria@bluehaven.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Price <alex.cfo@bluehaven.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Immediate: Surge causing 5xx and slow tails — production impact

Jonas / Redwood team,

We had a major degradation starting ~07:40 PDT — p95 latency spiked from 240ms to ~3.2s and error rate (5xx) climbed to 6.7% for our inference route (model: semi-provisioned-large). Throughput briefly saturated our reserved pool and many requests started queueing. We pulled a few sample traces and attach an excerpt.

Impact: customer-facing checkout and recommendations experienced timeouts; we observed retry storms from our side and some downstream rate-limit escalations. This is affecting about 18% of our traffic and it's customer-visible.

What we need immediately:
- Stand up an exec bridge now and confirm mitigation steps (rollback/route change).
- A clear owner for the RCA draft and expected timeline for a permanent fix.
- Confirmation whether this incident qualifies for SLA credit and how to start that process.

Attachments: error-sample.log (18KB), p95-latency-20280427.csv (6KB)

Please escalate: Alex (CFO) is copied as he needs a short impact summary for leadership.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Head of Platform Ops, BlueHaven
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@bluehaven.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Immediate: Surge causing 5xx and slow tails — production impact

Maria — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're starting an incident bridge now.

Immediate actions:
- I have asked Grace to open a high-priority bridge and notify on-call infra.
- Kimberly and Karthik will triage root cause and list mitigations we can apply in the next 60m.
- I'll coordinate a short exec readout for your leadership (eta 1h).

We will keep this thread as the single canonical touchpoint. More in the bridge.

—Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BlueHaven triage plan (do not forward)

Team — quick plan from bridge:
1) Triage timeline (30m): collect scheduler logs, GPU utilization, KV cache hit/miss ratios, and autoscaler events for the window 07:30–08:30 PDT.
2) Short mitigation (apply within 60m): reduce aggressive prewarm/autoscaler thresholds; temporarily route 10% of traffic to fallback smaller model to reduce queueing.
3) Medium-term fix (2–7 days): investigate background maintenance job that overlaps with scaling events; add safety caps to request queueing and improve backpressure signals.

Owners: Kimberly — root-cause dump and patch proposal; Karthik — autoscaler logs & immediate config changes; Grace — customer comms & exec sync.

Deliverables: initial RCA draft (kimberly) in 8–12 hours, mitigation verification and runbook updates in 48–72 hours.

Please reply with any blockers.

Jonas
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria@bluehaven.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Immediate: Surge causing 5xx and slow tails — production impact / RCA draft attached

Maria / team — attaching a technical RCA draft and the perf traces we captured. Summary (TL;DR):

Root cause (short): a confluence of (1) a background model warm-up job that temporarily saturates a small subset of GPUs on the reserved pool, and (2) an autoscaler policy that, under sustained degraded KV cache hit rates, interpreted the increased latency as capacity need and issued scale-up/scale-down oscillations. The oscillation plus saturated GPUs led to request queueing and client timeouts; retries amplified the queueing.

Evidence:
- perf-traces.json (attached) shows long tail latency correlating with background-job start times.
- autoscaler audit logs show repeated scale-down events at 07:42 then multiple scale-ups at 07:48.
- p95-latency-20280427.csv contains the metric jump.

Immediate mitigations applied (07:50–08:10 PDT):
- Disabled the background warm-up job for the affected pool.
- Temporarily tightened autoscaler hysteresis to avoid oscillation.
- Added a short-lived route to a smaller model variant for ~12% of traffic to reduce pressure.

Next steps / owner commitments:
- Kimberley: full RCA write-up and patch plan (deliverable: rca-draft.md, due 2028-04-27 20:00 UTC).
- Karthik: autoscaler policy hardening + canary config for rollback (due 2028-04-30).
- Grace: customer impact summary & proposed SLA credit process (due 2028-04-28).

Attachments: rca-draft.md, perf-traces.json

2) Provide a firm timeline for the permanent fix and any compensatory measures you will take should this happen again in the next 30 days.

Please include an accountable owner for the credit calculation and a POC for commercial/legal.

—Alex

Subject: Re: Immediate: Surge causing 5xx and slow tails — production impact

Alex — short answers:
- SLA credit: yes, this event meets the published incident thresholds. Grace will lead the credit estimate and coordinate with finance/legal to draft a formal credit note.
- Timeline for permanent fix: we will ship autoscaler policy hardening and a safety cap on background jobs in a canary next 72 hours, with full rollout within 7 days (target 2028-05-04). Kimberly/Karthik own the technical delivery.

Action owners: Grace (credit calc & customer comms), Kimberly (RCA & patch), Karthik (autoscaler canary).

I'll share a short exec note and a clean action tracker in this thread within 4 business hours.

Jonas

Date: Tue, 2 May 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Closure & commitments: BlueHaven incident (summary + tracking)

Team / Leadership — final summary and owner commitments for the BlueHaven production degradation (incident window: 2028-04-27 07:40–08:25 PDT).

Summary: root cause was autoscaler oscillation combined with an unthrottled warm-up job that transiently saturated GPUs. Immediate mitigations reduced customer impact within ~35 minutes.

Commitment tracker (owners & dates):
- Kimberly Park: RFC + full RCA doc and patch proposal (rca-draft.md) — DONE (2028-04-27).
- Karthik Iyer: Autoscaler policy hardening + canary (staged 2028-04-29, full rollout 2028-05-04).
- Grace O'Connor: SLA credit calculation and legal/commercial note to BlueHaven (submitted 2028-05-01).
- Ops: Add pre-deploy safety gate to prevent background jobs from co-scheduling with scaling events (target 2028-05-07).

Open items: document retrospective (owner: Jonas) and a short follow-up with BlueHaven leadership to review post-mortem and confirm credit acceptance (sched: 2028-05-06).

Links: bridge notes, ticket SUP-2134, RCA draft in Drive (see related_links).

This thread will remain the canonical record for the incident and commitments. Closing the incident to active bridging; reopening if BlueHaven requires additional follow-through.

—Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Reliability Operations, Redwood Inference
